author: Latin Business Daily
title: President Kast meets with Economy and Mining Minister to discuss growth and employment
text:
President Kast meets with Economy and Mining Minister to discuss growth and employment
President José Antonio Kast met with the Minister of Economy and Mining, Daniel Mas, at the Palacio de La Moneda on July 22 to review progress on the government's main economic and mining initiatives. The meeting focused on boosting investment, growth, and job creation.
The discussion took place as significant progress was being made in the legislative process for the National Reconstruction and Economic and Social Development bill. During the meeting, both officials reviewed advancements in key areas of the government's economic and mining agenda. Special emphasis was placed on promoting investment, increasing productivity, developing strategic projects, and generating employment opportunities.
According to information from the Ministry of Economy, this meeting is part of ongoing coordination efforts led by President Kast with his cabinet to monitor government priorities related to economic growth, development, and modernization.
The regular coordination meetings aim to ensure that progress is maintained across these priority areas.
